overview_description.description:
Zeal makes it faster, easier, and better for staffing companies to onboard, pay, and bill. Our solutions are purpose-built to help staffing companies lower operational costs, improve worker retention, and unlock new revenue streams.

Our onboarding solution allows you to automate worker onboarding so you can stay compliant and get workers started faster. Documents, tax forms, E-Signature contract collection, remote I-9 with E-Verify, certifications, and more all built into a unified onboarding flow.

Improve worker retention with fast payments and unlock new revenue streams with Instant Pay, Paycards and Digital Wallets. Payroll, taxes, payments, compliance and more — Zeal handles it all for you.

Our billing solutions make it easy to turn worker pay into accounts receivable, then invoice and collect payment from customers. Innovative routing and integrated capital make it simple to manage cash flow.

With Zeal you're able to create a fully-functional, branded worker app, in minutes. This is not the same old third-party portal. Deliver onboarding, I-9, paycards, benefits, paystubs, tax documents, and more through a no-code, well designed, modern app.

Built-in integrations allow you to connect best-in-class solutions to best-in-class onboard, pay, and bill. Simplify and automate workflows without sacrificing quality.

Employment regulation is complex and constantly changing. We’ve built our own compliance engine to ensure that you always maintain compliance across federal, state, and local regulations.

Zeal is more than software, we are a partner helping you craft better experiences for your workers, clients, and team. Our technology, people, and partnerships enable you to transform your operations and your business.

about_short_description.short_description: Zeal makes it faster, easier, and better for staffing companies to onboard, pay, and bill.

product.name: Onboard
product.description: Automates worker onboarding with compliant document collection, eSignatures, I-9 verification, certifications, and customizable data capture in a unified workflow.

product.name: Pay
product.description: Automates payroll processing, tax compliance, and payments with flexible schedules and instant pay options for 1099 and W-2 workers.

product.name: Bill
product.description: Simplifies billing by converting worker pay into accounts receivable, invoicing clients, and managing cash flow with integrated capital and routing.

product.name: Custom Branded Mobile App
product.description: Provides staffing companies with a no-code, custom branded mobile app for workers to onboard, access pay, benefits, and documents.

product.name: API and White-label Components
product.description: Offers APIs and white-label components to integrate Zeal’s onboarding, pay, and billing functionalities into existing staffing platforms.
